title: THERMOS FUNTAINER 12 Ounce Stainless Steel Vacuum Insulated Kids Straw Bottle, Spider-Man | Kids Stainless Steel Insulated Water Bottle, Keeps Drinks Cold Longer for School & Play, BPA-Free

reviews.title: Easy to use and light
reviews.body: Easy to use and easy to clean. My kid loves the avengers
reviews.author: twiggy

reviews.title: Inseparable
reviews.body: My son and this bottle are inseparable now 😂
reviews.author: ANGELINE

reviews.title: Weird print design. Looks like mold.
reviews.body: The items didnt come in a box. Just thin plastic bag only. We are lucky that the bottle came in good shape.The print on the bottle looks weird. As seen in the photos, i thought it is moldy.If i had to pay full price, i would have returned to get refund.Good thing is the bottle is light. The parts are easy to be taken out to wash and put back.
reviews.author: Wong Tsz Hin

reviews.title: Leaks
reviews.body: Not sure if I'm assembling this wrongly, but there is a tiny hole where water will seep out. when you turn the bottle upside down, water leaks. Can't bring this bottle outdoor since I will risk wetting the bag. Cute design and fairly light weighted for a stainless bottle though.
reviews.author: Public name

reviews.title: Easier to use
reviews.body: After my baby seems to just leak water as he's drinking from the munchkin straw cups and likes his water cold I decided to try this. He doesn't dribble now when he drinks I think the angle of the straw helps and keeps his water nice and cold in the miami heat. Great bottle.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on 10 July 2022
reviews.author: Haribonx

reviews.title: Recomendo
reviews.body: Excelente produto, mantêm a agua gelada e tem uma durabilidade muito boa
reviews.author: André Luiz Trindade de Medeiros

reviews.title: Good kids water bottle
reviews.body: Good water bottle overall, keeps water cold, tight seal.If the bottle is open and on its side it will slowly leak from straw. Other than that it’s great.
reviews.author: AshleyO

features: STAYS COLD: THERMOS vacuum insulation technology keeps drinks cold for up to 12 hours; Our kids water bottles are built so their drinks are as cool on the inside as they look on the outside; Not for hot liquids

DURABLE FOR DAILY USE: High quality 18/8 stainless steel construction is built to handle drops, dings and assorted roughhousing; You can pop your FUNTAINER water bottle in the dishwasher, though washing by hand is recommended

KID-FRIENDLY DESIGN: Choose from a variety of fun colors or patterns! This water bottle is lightweight and compact with a push button lid so it’s easy to carry and open; The integrated carry handle features a soft touch grip
HYGIENIC COVERED STRAW: Help keep germs away with a hygienically covered pop-up straw that’s also removable for easy cleaning
PROTECT WHAT YOU LOVE: This THERMOS KIDS gear is made with durable, dishwasher safe materials meant to keep lunch and drinks how they like them; The lunchtime puzzle is officially solved
